verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a public Sai API (REST plus a Python SDK) that developers and coding agents can use to submit plain-language tasks. They name concrete endpoints for streaming events, answering approvals and listing machines, and also document an MCP server installed with an API key. A probe confirms the developer docs site is live, but no OpenAPI spec was found at the usual paths. missing for 10: a published machine-readable OpenAPI/reference spec, explicit documentation of the task-submission endpoint, independent or hands-on corroboration that the API works as described.
